concept: CloudFront: CDN caching at the edge
tests: How to speed up global loading of a static site and serve cache during origin outages.
expected: S3 as origin + a CloudFront distribution: caching at edge locations, low latency, and cached content served during brief origin outages. Triggers: "static website", "global users", "load quickly worldwide", "origin outages for cached content".
why_not: Direct S3 access in one Region means high latency for distant users; EC2 in one Region isn't global; EBS can't be shared globally.
